bindings.caption: Prepare oleylamine reactor with two addition funnels, Claisen adapter and cold trap. 2L three-neck reactor, condenser,5cm elliptic stirrer600–900rpm; Claisen adapter between reactor and condenser; cold trap above condenser. Mainp5 mentions four-neck flask only as optional alternative, not the used setup. Mainp2 uses50cm double-wall reflux condenser; TableS1 lists >50cm overall condenser height, internal cooling coil, elliptic50mm×20mm stirrer and2L three-neck flask. Dimensions are source annotations, not a scale drawing. Mainp2 requires supported reactor and source-limited thermal-difference precautions; no new apparatus specification supplied. Continuing source reactor:2L, three necks, reflux condenser; schematic scale.

general_background.title: Injection and precursor supply
general_background.summary: Rapid injection can concentrate precursor conversion near the start of a reaction, helping distinguish nucleation from subsequent growth. A short period of rapid precursor conversion can favour nucleation, while a later lower supply can favour growth on existing particles.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

general_background.title: Solvent and transport
general_background.summary: A solvent carries dissolved species and transports heat through a reaction or dispersion. Solubility, viscosity and molecular interactions affect how precursors and ligand-coated particles move and mix.
